opportunities.name: AP bomb jump assassin
opportunities.objective: Test ap bomb jump assassin against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Explosive Charge has 0.5 AP physical scaling before its four-hit doubling; Buster Shot has 1.0 AP magic scaling and W adds 0.5 AP magic damage. Nashor and Lich Bane support stacking E with real attacks before a max-stack detonation refreshes W.
opportunities.requiredState: Apply E, land four valid hits and reserve R knockback direction.
opportunities.failure: Physical E resists magic penetration and failure to detonate strands W.
opportunities.test: Measure E physical damage separately from W/R magic burst.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP does not turn E magic and turret bomb detonation does not grant the champion-only W reset.

opportunities.name: Health bomb reset fighter
opportunities.objective: Test health bomb reset fighter against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Rapid Fire grants up to 120% attack speed for seven seconds; Titanic and Bloodmail trade some conventional crit DPS for health and physical attacks while E stacks. Hexplate supports attacks after R and Essence Reaver supplies physical Spellblade plus mana; partial crit still improves E's documented multiplier.
opportunities.requiredState: Connect E-stack attacks and choose R timing without knocking the target out early.
opportunities.failure: Low damage prevents max-stack detonation and reset before retaliation.
opportunities.test: Compare time to four E stacks and health after a W-in trade.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Ability hits can stack E, but item splash is not assumed to be four independent bomb stacks.

ruledOut.reason: AP does not turn E magic and turret bomb detonation does not grant the champion-only W reset.

unknowns: Current-patch proc ordering/effectiveness is untested; symbolic source stats and helper form/pet records are not runtime dispatch proof.

builds.name: AP bomb jump assassin
builds.summary: Test ap bomb jump assassin against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test ap bomb jump assassin against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Explosive Charge has 0.5 AP physical scaling before its four-hit doubling; Buster Shot has 1.0 AP magic scaling and W adds 0.5 AP magic damage. Nashor and Lich Bane support stacking E with real attacks before a max-stack detonation refreshes W.
testPlan: Required state: Apply E, land four valid hits and reserve R knockback direction.
Measure E physical damage separately from W/R magic burst.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Physical E resists magic penetration and failure to detonate strands W.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: AP does not turn E magic and turret bomb detonation does not grant the champion-only W reset.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Banshee's Veil, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Tristana's Attacks that kill enemies deal [45 / 60 / 75 / 90 / 105 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Active: Tristana attaches a bomb to an enemy or turret that deals [(60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.5) × AP) × ((1 + ((0.4) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage to surrounding enemies after [4] seconds. The damage is increased by [25]% each time Tristana hits an Attack or Ability (max 4 stacks).

At [4] stacks, the bomb explodes immediately (max [((60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.5) × AP) × ((1 + ((0.4) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))) × ((1 + (0.25) × (4)))] physical damage).

Tristana fires a massive cannonball, dealing [225 / 275 / 325 + (0.7) × AD[statFormula=2] + (1) × AP] magic damage to the target, Knocking Back and Stunning them and surrounding enemies for [0.4 / 0.55 / 0.7] seconds.
Tristana goes full-auto, gaining [(0.6 / 0.75 / 0.9 / 1.05 / 1.2) × 100]% Attack Speed for [7] seconds.

Tristana launches herself, dealing [70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.5) × AP] magic damage and Slowing by [40]% for [2] seconds upon landing.

Champion takedowns and max stack {{Spell_TristanaE_Name}} detonations on champions refresh this Ability's Cooldown.
